provenance: Generated by CreditProbe v5 from the books (PLAN_R9 Session A); keyed to the book IDs. Counterparty, person and company names are invented; no real customer is described.

dictionary.book: corporate or retail: the book the row belongs to.
dictionary.obligor_id: The obligor: borrower_id (CB#####) in corporate, customer_id (RC######) in retail.
dictionary.exposure_id: The exposure: facility_id (CF…) in corporate, account_id (RA…) in retail.
dictionary.group_id: The borrower's group in the corporate book (CG####).
dictionary.routing_required_x: Turnover the borrower undertook to route through the bank, as a multiple of its limits.
dictionary.routing_actual_x: Credit turnover of the last 12 months as a multiple of the borrower's total limits.
dictionary.turnover_to_revenue: Credit turnover of the last 12 months over annual revenue.
dictionary.returned_cheque_rate_pct: Cheques returned as a share of cheques deposited, last 12 months.
dictionary.balance_volatility: Standard deviation over mean of month-end balances, last 12 months.
dictionary.sicr_flag: The book's SICR flag (sicr_reasons lists the CBUAE indicators present, flagged or not).
dictionary.sicr_reasons: JSON list of SICR indicators present: code, text, CBUAE article, clause ID, source and date.
dictionary.utp_flag: 1 when the exposure is Stage 3 or in default in the book.
dictionary.utp_reasons: JSON list of unlikeliness-to-pay indicators present.
dictionary.article: CBUAE CRM article and sub-item, e.g. 7.11(a).
dictionary.watch_status: None, Accepted Risk Watch or Bank Watchlist.
dictionary.run_id: ECL run: 2026Q3 (current, equals the books at book_period) or 2026Q2 (prior).
dictionary.book_period: The book period the ECL run row was taken from.
dictionary.ecl_weighted_sar_mn: Scenario-weighted ECL (base 50%, upside 20%, downside 30%) before overlay.
dictionary.rerun_required: 1 when the anomaly changes ECL materially and the run should be repeated.
dictionary.nominee_flag: 1 when the shareholding is held through a nominee.
dictionary.as_of_date: The date the row is as of: the book's as-of quarter-end (corporate) or month-end (retail).
dictionary.tier1_capital_sar_mn: Capital base used for large exposures: 17% of total CRWA (the repo-wide proxy, data_loader.CAPITAL_RATIO).
dictionary.amount_sar_mn: Amount paid to or received from the counterparty in the month.
dictionary.anomaly_id: Identifier of the ECL input anomaly.
dictionary.avg_balance_sar_mn: Average daily balance across the obligor's deposit accounts in the month.
dictionary.avg_relationship_deposits_sar_mn: Average month-end deposits of the relationship over the last 12 months.
dictionary.breach: 1 when the group's exposure exceeds the large-exposure limit.
dictionary.category: Counterparty category: customer, supplier, related or government.
dictionary.cheque_return_reason: Main reason the returned cheques were returned in the month.
dictionary.cheques_deposited_count: Number of cheques deposited in the month.
dictionary.cheques_deposited_sar_mn: Value of cheques deposited in the month.
dictionary.cheques_returned_count: Number of deposited cheques returned unpaid in the month.
dictionary.cheques_returned_sar_mn: Value of deposited cheques returned unpaid in the month.
dictionary.cif: Internal customer number of the node, where it is a bank customer.
dictionary.code: Reason code of the SICR or unlikeliness-to-pay indicator.
dictionary.collateral_sar_mn: Collateral value fed to the ECL engine for this exposure.
dictionary.count_24m: Number of restructurings in the last 24 months.
dictionary.counterparty_cif: Internal customer number of the counterparty when it banks with us.
dictionary.credit_turnover_sar_mn: Total credits (inflows) to the obligor's accounts in the month.
dictionary.credit_txn_count: Number of credit transactions in the month.
dictionary.crm_sar_mn: Credit risk mitigation recognised: eligible collateral after haircut, capped at EAD.
dictionary.crwa_sar_mn: Credit risk-weighted assets of the exposure.
dictionary.current_value: Value of the field in the run the anomaly sits in (current run unless stated).
dictionary.debit_turnover_sar_mn: Total debits (outflows) from the obligor's accounts in the month.
dictionary.debit_txn_count: Number of debit transactions in the month.
dictionary.deferrals_24m: Number of instalment deferrals in a rolling 24 months.
dictionary.direction: Direction of the flow: in (received) or out (paid).
dictionary.ecl_base_sar_mn: ECL under the base scenario (before overlay).
dictionary.ecl_downside_sar_mn: ECL under the downside scenario (before overlay).
dictionary.ecl_sar_mn: Expected credit loss reported, including overlay (equals the books in the current run).
dictionary.ecl_upside_sar_mn: ECL under the upside scenario (before overlay).
dictionary.eom_balance_sar_mn: Month-end balance across the obligor's deposit accounts.
dictionary.ews_bucket: Early Warning band of the exposure at the as-of.
dictionary.ews_signals: JSON list of the Early Warning signals that fired.
dictionary.excess_days: Days in the month the overdraft was above its limit.
dictionary.expected: What a consistent input would show.
dictionary.exposure_sar_mn: Exposure of the related party with the bank.
dictionary.field: The input field the anomaly is in.
dictionary.guarantor_cif: Internal customer number of the guarantor.
dictionary.guarantor_type: Type of guarantor: corporate or personal.

haircut_pct.description: Haircut applied to the collateral value.

hurdle_rate_pct.description: Return hurdle the facility had to clear at approval.

dictionary.kind: Kind of reason (SICR or UTP) or of anomaly.
dictionary.large_exposure: 1 when the group's exposure is at least 10% of Tier 1 capital.
dictionary.lien_sar_mn: Amount of the deposit held under lien.

limit_pct.description: Large-exposure limit as a share of Tier 1 capital.

dictionary.limit_sar_mn: Credit limit (in ECL runs: the limit fed to the engine).
dictionary.link_type: Type of link: group member, guarantor, shareholder, sponsor, officer, staff link or counterparty.
dictionary.max_balance_sar_mn: Highest daily balance in the month.
dictionary.members: Number of borrowers in the group.
dictionary.min_balance_sar_mn: Lowest daily balance in the month.
dictionary.name: Name of the network node.
dictionary.node_id: Identifier of the network node (borrower, group or person ID).
dictionary.node_type: Type of node: obligor, group or person.
dictionary.note: What the anomaly is and what it does to ECL.
dictionary.od_limit_sar_mn: Overdraft limit on the account (the book's overdraft facilities).

orig_margin_pct.description: Margin over the benchmark at origination.

dictionary.orig_rating: Rating (corporate) or score band (retail) at origination.
dictionary.party_cif: Identifier of the related party (borrower or person).
dictionary.payroll_flag: 1 when the obligor's payroll runs through the bank.
dictionary.payroll_headcount: Number of employees paid through the bank in the month.
dictionary.payroll_sar_mn: Payroll paid (corporate) or salary received (retail) in the month.

pct_of_capital.description: Group exposure as a share of Tier 1 capital.

peak_od_use_pct.description: Peak overdraft use in the month as a share of the limit.

dictionary.period: The book period of the classification (corporate quarter or retail month).
dictionary.previous_stage: IFRS 9 stage at the previous book period.
dictionary.prior_value: Value of the field in the prior run.
dictionary.probation_end: Month the restructuring probation period ends.

profit_rate_pct.description: Profit or interest rate paid on the account.

dictionary.rank: Rank of the counterparty by amount in the month (1 largest).
dictionary.rating: Borrower rating (corporate) or behaviour score band (retail).
dictionary.registration_status: Whether the collateral is registered: Registered, Pending or Not registered.
dictionary.relation: How the party is related to the obligor.
dictionary.restructured_flag: 1 when the exposure has been restructured.

risk_weight_pct.description: Risk weight applied to the exposure net of mitigation.

share_pct.description: Shareholding or ownership share on the link.

dictionary.source: Register or dataset the link comes from.
dictionary.source_dataset: Dataset the indicator was read from.
dictionary.status: Status of the account or restructuring.
dictionary.valuation_date: Date of the latest collateral valuation.
dictionary.routing_compliant: 1 when routing meets the undertaking, 0 when not, -1 when not applicable (retail).
